facts.statement: Community parties were held every Thursday and Friday in a different location, and players were invited to bring friends.
facts.quote: Rendez-vous tous les jeudis et vendredis avec la communauté pour faire la fête dans un lieu différent

facts.statement: The party of Friday 7 January 2011 was held on a stage at Snowy Hill (Colline des Neiges) on Server 1, starting 18:00 CET (4:00pm GMT).
facts.quote: sur une scène à la Colline des Neiges sur le serveur 1

facts.statement: Players were told to bring their favorite outfits and a boom box to the party.
facts.quote: N’oublie pas d’apporter tes tenues préférées et boom boxe!

article_summaries.title: Evénement: La Première Fête de 2011!
article_summaries.summary: A French-language community event post announcing the first party of 2011. Free Realms community parties were held on Thursdays and Fridays at a rotating location, and this week's party was on a stage at Snowy Hill (Colline des Neiges) on Server 1 on Friday 7 January 2011. Players were asked to bring favorite outfits and a boom box.
